description: Source code for verifying digital signatures using OpenSSL, including functions to read files, load public keys, and perform RSA signature verification.

methods.name: readFileContents
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into memory, returning a buffer and setting the file length.

methods.name: loadPublicKey
methods.description: Loads a public key from memory buffer into an EVP_PKEY structure using OpenSSL.

methods.name: RSAVerifySignature
methods.description: Performs RSA signature verification using SHA-256 digest.

methods.name: verifySignature
methods.description: Main function to verify the signature of a file given a public key, data file, and signature file.
